evidence.title: GeForce NOW Gives Gamers More Ways to Play at Gamescom 2026

summary: Nvidia unveiled new AI-powered enhancements to its GeForce NOW cloud gaming service at Gamescom 2026, offering gamers additional ways to access and play titles. The updates include AI-optimized streaming quality, instant game launches, and integration with Nvidia's latest GPU hardware, aiming to broaden the platform's reach.
title: Nvidia expands GeForce NOW with AI-driven features at Gamescom 2026
